Welcome to Northgate

Four floors, two hundred thousand volumes, and a reading room that has been open to the public since 1908.

Use the catalogue to find a record, apply for membership in three short steps, or read the latest notice from the librarians.

Where to start

  • Search the catalogue — find records by title or subject.
  • Browse the catalogue — twenty records a page, newest first.
  • Apply for membership — name, email, home branch.
  • Reading room refurbishment — what changed and when.
  • Archive ledger — sixty bundles from the trustees' index.
  • Member notices — requires acknowledging the data notice.
  • Noticeboard — some of its links open a second tab.
  • Cancel a reservation — the browser asks before it acts.
  • Export the ledger — offers a file rather than a page.
  • Live shelf display — has a control that never sits still.

Northgate Public Library, Hollow Lane. Registered charity 1104772.

Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm. Closed Sundays and bank holidays.
